title: What Are CD-SEM and SEM Review? A Simple Guide to Semiconductor Inspection and Metrology That Measures Dimensions and Examines Defects
excerpt: CD-SEM and SEM review are inspection and metrology steps in semiconductor manufacturing that measure line width and hole diameter and examine defects at high magnification. This beginner-friendly guide covers CD measurement SEM, failure analysis, and the keywords you see in job postings.
